name: ui-ux-standard
description: Reusable UI/UX workflow for design systems, mockups, media prompts, visual assets, accessibility, responsive QA, and frontend visual validation.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize mockups, design systems, assets, accessibility, and visual QA.
interface.longDescription: UI/UX Standard gives Codex a repeatable workflow for creating and reviewing product UI: inspect existing design systems, define design tokens, create approved mockups, manage media prompt PRDs, document components, validate accessibility and responsiveness, and verify rendered UI before frontend completion.
defaultPrompt: Use UI/UX Standard to create the design plan and mockup workflow for this feature.
Use UI/UX Standard to initialize docs/design for this project.
Use UI/UX Standard to review this UI against the approved mockup and design system.
